description: This file is a shell script for setting up and executing various Git repository tests involving ref namespaces, push and pull operations, branch setups, and ref hiding mechanics.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, executing the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Creates a timestamp for test commits.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified content.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or tests git configuration for tests.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output or file.
